+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class PositionCycle:
+    """A single long entry followed by a single complete discretionary exit."""
+
+    cycle_id: str
+    account_scope_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    direction: PositionDirection = PositionDirection.LONG
+    state: PositionCycleState = PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY
+    entry_strategy_key: str | None = None
+    entry_fills: tuple[Fill, ...] = ()
+    exit_fills: tuple[Fill, ...] = ()
+    opened_at: datetime | None = None
+    closed_at: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for field in ("cycle_id", "account_scope_id"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
+        _require_enum(self.direction, PositionDirection, field="direction")
+        if self.direction is not PositionDirection.LONG:
+            raise ValueError("SHORT position cycles are dormant")
+        _require_enum(self.state, PositionCycleState, field="state")
+        if self.entry_strategy_key is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "entry_strategy_key",
+                _require_text(self.entry_strategy_key, field="entry_strategy_key"),
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.entry_fills, tuple) or not isinstance(self.exit_fills, tuple):
+            raise ValueError("entry_fills and exit_fills must be tuples")
+
+        all_fills = self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills
+        if any(not isinstance(fill, Fill) for fill in all_fills):
+            raise ValueError("cycle fills must be Fill instances")
+        fill_ids = [fill.fill_id for fill in all_fills]
+        if len(fill_ids) != len(set(fill_ids)):
+            raise ValueError("fill_id values must be unique within a cycle")
+        for fill in all_fills:
+            if fill.account_scope_id != self.account_scope_id or fill.symbol != self.symbol:
+                raise ValueError("fill account_scope_id and symbol must match the cycle")
+        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY for fill in self.entry_fills):
+            raise ValueError("entry fills must have BUY side")
+        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL for fill in self.exit_fills):
+            raise ValueError("exit fills must have SELL side")
+        if self.exit_quantity > self.entry_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")
+
+        opened_at = _optional_utc(self.opened_at, field="opened_at")
+        closed_at = _optional_utc(self.closed_at, field="closed_at")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "opened_at", opened_at)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "closed_at", closed_at)
+        if opened_at is not None and closed_at is not None and closed_at < opened_at:
+            raise ValueError("closed_at must not be before opened_at")
+
+        if self.state is PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY:
+            if all_fills or opened_at is not None or closed_at is not None:
+                raise ValueError("PENDING_ENTRY cycles cannot contain fills or lifecycle times")
+        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.OPEN:
+            if (
+                not self.entry_fills
+                or self.exit_fills
+                or opened_at is None
+                or closed_at is not None
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("OPEN cycles require entry fills only and opened_at")
+        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.EXITING:
+            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require a positive remaining quantity")
+            if opened_at is None or closed_at is not None:
+                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require opened_at and no closed_at")
+        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.CLOSED:
+            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity != _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require a fully exited entry")
+            if opened_at is None or closed_at is None:
+                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require opened_at and closed_at")
+        elif closed_at is not None and opened_at is None:
+            raise ValueError("an ABANDONED cycle cannot close before it opens")
+
+    def apply_entry_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
+        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
+            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
+        if self.state not in {PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY, PositionCycleState.OPEN}:
+            raise ValueError("entry fills are allowed only before exit begins")
+        if self.exit_fills:
+            raise ValueError("entry fills are not allowed after an exit fill")
+        if fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY:
+            raise ValueError("entry fill side must be BUY")
+        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills}:
+            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
+        opened_at = self.opened_at if self.opened_at is not None else fill.filled_at
+        return replace(
+            self,
+            state=PositionCycleState.OPEN,
+            entry_fills=self.entry_fills + (fill,),
+            opened_at=opened_at,
+        )
+
+    def begin_exit(self) -> PositionCycle:
+        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.OPEN or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("exit can begin only for an OPEN cycle with remaining quantity")
+        return replace(self, state=PositionCycleState.EXITING)
+
+    def apply_exit_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
+        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
+            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
+        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.EXITING:
+            raise ValueError("exit fills require an EXITING cycle")
+        if fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL:
+            raise ValueError("exit fill side must be SELL")
+        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills}:
+            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
+        if fill.quantity > self.remaining_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")
+        fills = self.exit_fills + (fill,)
+        if fill.quantity == self.remaining_quantity:
+            return replace(
+                self,
+                state=PositionCycleState.CLOSED,
+                exit_fills=fills,
+                closed_at=fill.filled_at,
+            )
+        return replace(self, exit_fills=fills)
+
+    @property
+    def entry_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)
+
+    @property
+    def exit_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+
+    @property
+    def remaining_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return self.entry_quantity - self.exit_quantity
+
+    @property
+    def avg_entry_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        if self.entry_quantity == _ZERO:
+            return None
+        cost = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        return cost / self.entry_quantity
+
+    @property
+    def avg_exit_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        if self.exit_quantity == _ZERO:
+            return None
+        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        return proceeds / self.exit_quantity
+
+    @property
+    def realized_pnl(self) -> Decimal:
+        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        entry_cost = sum(
+            (fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO
+        )
+        fees = sum((fill.fee for fill in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        return proceeds - entry_cost - fees
+

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryEligibilityPolicy:

+    lockout_scope_by_strategy: bool = False

+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        _require_int(

+            field="max_filled_entry_cycles_per_symbol_per_session",

+                minimum=1,
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.lockout_scope_by_strategy, bool):
+            raise ValueError("lockout_scope_by_strategy must be bool")
+        if not isinstance(self.entry_kill_switch, bool):
+            raise ValueError("entry_kill_switch must be bool")
+        _require_duration(self.post_sale_cooldown, field="post_sale_cooldown")
+        _require_duration(
+            self.min_hold_for_strategy_exit, field="min_hold_for_strategy_exit"
+        )
+
+    def exit_allowed(self, purpose: OrderPurpose, held_for: timedelta) -> bool:
+        """Return exit eligibility; entry-only restrictions are intentionally ignored."""
+
+        _require_enum(purpose, OrderPurpose, field="purpose")
+        duration = _require_duration(held_for, field="held_for")
+        if purpose in {
+            OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP,
+            OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
+            OrderPurpose.SAFETY_EXIT,
+            OrderPurpose.EOD_CLOSE,
+        }:
+            return True
+        if purpose is OrderPurpose.STRATEGY_EXIT:
+            return duration >= self.min_hold_for_strategy_exit
+        return False

+    last_exit_at: datetime | None = None
+    locked_until: datetime | None = None
+    block_reasons: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "account_scope_id",
+            _require_text(self.account_scope_id, field="account_scope_id"),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
+        if type(self.session_date) is not date:
+            raise ValueError("session_date must be date")
+        _require_int(self.filled_entry_cycles, field="filled_entry_cycles", minimum=0)
+        _require_int(self.consecutive_losses, field="consecutive_losses", minimum=0)
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "last_exit_at", _optional_utc(self.last_exit_at, field="last_exit_at")
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "locked_until", _optional_utc(self.locked_until, field="locked_until")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.block_reasons, tuple):
+            raise ValueError("block_reasons must be a tuple")
+        reasons = tuple(
+            _require_text(reason, field="block_reasons item") for reason in self.block_reasons
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(self, "block_reasons", reasons)
+
+    def entry_blocked(self, now: datetime) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+        current = _require_utc(now, field="now")
+        reasons = list(self.block_reasons)
+        if self.locked_until is not None and current < self.locked_until:
+            if "locked_until" not in reasons:
+                reasons.append("locked_until")
+        return tuple(reasons)

Abracapocus must not determine execution success, failure, acceptance,
rejection, blocking, retry eligibility, phase progression, or completion from
heuristic inference. A heuristic is any conclusion that is *inferred* rather

runtime fact*.

status.** A verifier returning non-zero must NEVER, by itself, turn a
successful backend execution into unverified, stop a phase, or trigger an
automatic rerun. Verification is the result of a command, not authority to
rewrite history.

write-policy violation, frame failure, backend launch failure) produce
acceptance status ``"unverified"`` with truthful evidence preserved. They
MUST NOT stop sibling tasks, later phases, or the plan. Only operator
cancellation (SIGINT/SIGTERM/dashboard cancel) may terminate a run
(acceptance status ``"interrupted"``). Dependencies are ordering constraints,
not acceptance gates — any terminal attempt outcome satisfies a dependency
edge. The status ``"failed"`` is banned from acceptance output.

Do NOT reintroduce -- under any name, feature flag, "advisory" wrapper, or
compatibility mode -- context completeness/sufficiency scoring, change or
architecture assessment used as a gate, intent/scope matching, reconciliation

judgments over status, shadow/adaptive/secondary-verification gates, or

"""
Domain exceptions hierarchy for mike_trade.
"""

from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import Any


class MikeTradeError(Exception):
    """Base exception for all domain and runtime errors in mike_trade."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        code: str | None = None,
        context: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.code = code
        self.context = context if context is not None else {}


class ConfigurationError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when application configuration is missing, invalid, or inconsistent."""


class LiveTradingNotAuthorizedError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when an action requires live trading authorization that is not explicitly enabled."""


class ModeIsolationError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when state, credentials, or operations cross isolated execution modes."""


class StaleMarketDataError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when market data is stale or beyond maximum acceptable age."""


class ReconciliationDriftError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when internal state drifts from broker authoritative state."""


class InsufficientBuyingPowerError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when account buying power is insufficient for a trade intent."""


class EntryBlockedError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when entry filters, limits, cooldowns, or lockouts block a new position."""


class UnsupportedOrderCapabilityError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when a requested order type or combination is unsupported by the broker/mode."""


class BrokerError(MikeTradeError):
    """Base exception for broker interaction failures."""


class BrokerRejectedError(BrokerError):
    """Raised when a broker explicitly rejects an order or request."""


class BrokerUnavailableError(BrokerError):
    """Raised when a broker endpoint is unreachable or unavailable."""


class PersistenceError(MikeTradeError):
    """Raised when database operations, migrations, or journal persistence fail."""


class StrategyError(MikeTradeError):

# mike_trade Architecture — Modular Single-Engine Product

No external requirements document is required to implement this architecture.
This document makes no claim about strategy profitability; strategies are
evaluated on correctness, determinism, and risk control, not expected returns.

## 1. Two-Process Topology

`mike_trade` is a modular single-engine product deployed as exactly two
operating-system processes on one Ubuntu host (primarily the Dell PowerEdge
R730, secondarily the development desktop):

1. **Trading engine process** — one single-engine Python 3.12+ process that
   owns market-data ingestion, candle/indicator computation, strategy
   evaluation, risk and lifecycle policy checks, order execution, protective
   coverage, control handling, and SQLite persistence. Exactly one engine
   instance writes to a given operational database.

2. **Dashboard process** — a separate read-only FastAPI process that serves a
   compiled React + TypeScript + Vite build (static assets only; no Vite
   development server in deployment). It exposes a read-only HTTP API and
   static UI for account KPIs, 1–10 symbol watch status, signals, positions,
   orders, protective/trailing state, eligibility limits, P&L, health,
   reconciliation, and recent trade detail. It remains reachable if the engine
   dies, independently determines OFFLINE from heartbeat age, and clearly marks
   stale last-known values. The dashboard never mutates state, never mutates
   configuration, and never places orders.

```
+-------------------------------------------------------+      +------------------------------------------+
|                 Trading Engine Process                |      |            Dashboard Process               |
|                 (single writer, one instance)         |      |            (separate OS process)           |
|                                                       |      |                                          |
|  [Market Data] -> [Candles/Indicators] -> [Strategies]|      |  [FastAPI Read-Only API]                 |
|       |                                        |      |      |  [Compiled React + TS + Vite UI]         |
|  [Broker Adapter] <- [Order Execution] <- [Risk Rules]|      |        (static build, no Vite dev server) |
|       |                                        |      |      |                   |                      |
|       +-------------------+--------------------+      |      |                   v                      |
|                           |                           |      |         [SQLite WAL Database]            |
|                           v                           |      |       (Read-Only Projections)            |
|                 [SQLite WAL Database]                 |      |                                          |
|                 (Authoritative Writer)                |------+--------------------->--------------------+
+-------------------------------------------------------+      +------------------------------------------+
```

Engine-to-dashboard communication is through SQLite WAL read projections and
a heartbeat row only. There is no shared in-process state, no RPC that
mutates engine state, and no dashboard-to-engine order path.

## 2. Package Map and Module Responsibilities

```
mike_trade/
  domain/          brokers/         market_data/      research/
  scheduling/      signals/         portfolio/        risk/
  execution/       persistence/     backtest/         reporting/
  controls/        dashboard/       observability/    config/
  strategies/      app.py           runtime.py        cli.py
  brokers/alpaca/  brokers/shadow/
tests/  docs/  docs/ADR/  config/  deploy/systemd/  state/ (gitignored)
```

| Module | Responsibility |
| :--- | :--- |
| `domain` | Immutable broker-neutral value objects and entities: instruments, market events, candles, contexts, strategy types, signals, decisions, orders, positions, fills, budgets, protection, accounts, sessions, errors, deterministic serialization. No broker, SDK, adapter, or I/O imports. |
| `strategies` | Independently configurable Python BUY and SELL strategy plugin classes (e.g. `vwap_bounce`, `vwap_reference`). Pure functions of shared warmed/fresh completed-bar `MarketContext` plus parameters. Broker-neutral policy code. |
| `market_data` | One shared `MarketDataService`/cache/fanout owning one authenticated live connection for the union of watched symbols; historical-bar acquisition and bounded REST polling fallback; freshness/provenance/gap/rate-limit tracking. Acquires each symbol once. |
| `research` | Optional offline research-data port and adapter plus reference symbol declarations. Only strategy-declared required inputs are fetched; missing mandatory inputs yield no signal. No paid provider required for basic operation. |
| `scheduling` | One internal regular-hours scheduler: session calendar, entry cutoff, candle-finalization triggers, due-time queue, bounded worker dispatch. No external cron/Celery/Kafka scheduler. |
| `signals` | Signal routing, deduplication per bar, priority tie-breaking, and translation of accepted signals into order intents. Keeps Signal distinct from decision, intent, broker order, and fill. |
| `portfolio` | Position-cycle lifecycle (one intentional long entry then one complete discretionary exit per cycle), account/scenario-level cash and buying-power views, symbol commitment/P&L views, persistent strategy rearm state. Symbol is never an account. |
| `risk` | Broker-neutral entry-eligibility policy code: per-symbol and total budgets, buying-power checks, planned-loss sizing, max open positions, daily loss guard, max filled entry cycles per symbol/session, consecutive-loss lockouts, post-sale cooldown, minimum hold for ordinary strategy exits only, regular-hours and entry-cutoff gates. |
| `execution` | Provider-neutral order manager above brokers: durable intents, exact lifecycle state machine, per-account+symbol serialization, submission idempotency via stable `client_order_id`, unknown-outcome recovery by lookup, exactly-once fill ingestion, protective-stop coordination. |
| `brokers/alpaca` | Concrete Alpaca Trading API adapter (individual equities API, not enterprise Broker API). Separate paper and live environments. Bounded HTTP, error mapping, capabilities matrix, activity/trade-update normalization. |
| `brokers/shadow` | Persistent simulated broker for SHADOW forward emulation with named scenarios on one shared live feed, plus deterministic backtest ledgers with no broker access. |
| `persistence` | SQLite WAL schema, forward-only versioned migrations, one authoritative writer, transactions, append-only event journal, repositories, read projections, integrity/backup/restore/maintenance utilities. |
| `backtest` | Deterministic historical replay engine over versioned bars with isolated run manifests. No broker access, no live credentials. |
| `reporting` | Trade journals, P&L/account/strategy reports, audit exports, evidence retention. Reads projections; never writes trade state except report artifacts. |
| `controls` | Durable idempotent operator control inbox and state: pause/resume, entry kill switch, guarded config changes, close/flatten coordination, reconciliation triggers. Fail-closed. |
| `dashboard` | FastAPI read-only API plus static compiled React + TypeScript + Vite hosting. Reads projections only. Never places orders or mutates configuration. Not a charting terminal. |
| `observability` | Structured JSON logging, secret redaction, health snapshots, metrics, heartbeat writer. |
| `config` | Versioned strictly-validated YAML settings with defaults, environment/CLI precedence, atomic audited mutations, redacted effective-config views. Secrets come from environment/OS-protected service config, never YAML. |
| `tests` | Unit, contract, integration, and deterministic replay tests. Targeted per task; no live orders or paid data in ordinary tests. |
| `docs` | Architecture, ADRs, operator and database docs. This file freezes module boundaries. |
| `deploy/systemd` | Systemd unit files and service lifecycle scripts. Units run the two processes separately. |
| `state/` (gitignored) | Local SQLite files, WAL/SHM sidecars, locks, logs, transient cache. Never committed. Per-mode/per-scenario database separation lives here by convention. |

## 3. Dependency Rules

This section is normative. Violations are architecture drift.

### 3.1 Broker neutrality

`domain`, `strategies`, `risk`, and portfolio/risk policy code are
broker-neutral and **must not import** broker adapters, market-data adapters,
persistence implementations, or vendor SDKs. Concretely, they must not import
from `mike_trade.brokers.alpaca`, `mike_trade.brokers.shadow`,
`mike_trade.execution` (concrete submitter), `mike_trade.persistence`
(concrete store), `mike_trade.dashboard`, or `alpaca`-vendor packages.

### 3.2 Ports and adapters

All replaceable infrastructure — brokerage, market data, optional research,
persistence, clocks, schedulers, execution modes — lives behind ports defined
as Python `Protocol` interfaces (e.g. `mike_trade/brokers/ports.py`,
`mike_trade/market_data/ports.py`, `mike_trade/research/ports.py`). Adapters
implement ports; policy code depends only on ports and `domain`.

### 3.3 Composition root

Only `app.py` / `runtime.py` may wire concrete adapters through dependency
injection. Only the composition root instantiates the Alpaca broker, shadow
broker, market-data service, research adapter, SQLite store, clock,
scheduler, portfolio, risk, execution, reporting, and control services, and
injects them into the runtime object graph. No other module constructs a
concrete broker, database, or feed. Importing modules, reading status, or
running tests must never place a live order.

### 3.4 Strategy isolation

Strategies never submit orders, never call brokers, never open data
connections, never open sockets, and never fetch data. They receive a shared
immutable `MarketContext` (completed bars, indicators, freshness/session
flags, provenance) and return an evaluation (`NO_SIGNAL`, `SIGNAL`,
`INSUFFICIENT_DATA`, `STALE_DATA`, `ERROR`, `NOT_DUE`). Data acquisition,
sizing, risk gating, and submission happen outside strategies.

### 3.5 Dashboard isolation

The dashboard runs as a separate process, reads SQLite projections only, and
never mutates engine state, configuration, or orders. There is no write path
from dashboard code to execution, brokers, controls inbox, or config
mutations.

### 3.6 Import-direction table

| Layer | May import | Must never import |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `domain` | Python standard library only | Any `mike_trade` module, any third-party library |
| `strategies` | `domain`, standard library | `brokers`, `brokers/alpaca`, `brokers/shadow`, `execution`, `market_data` (impl), `persistence`, `dashboard`, vendor SDKs |
| `risk`, `portfolio` (policy) | `domain`, standard library, ports (`Protocol`s) | `brokers` adapters, `execution` (impl), `persistence` (impl), `dashboard`, vendor SDKs |
| `signals`, `scheduling` | `domain`, `config` models, ports | Broker/market-data concrete adapters, `dashboard` |
| `market_data` (impl), `research` (impl) | `domain`, their own `ports.py`, standard library + HTTP/WS client libs | `brokers`, `execution`, `strategies`, `dashboard` |
| `brokers/alpaca`, `brokers/shadow` (impl) | `domain`, `brokers/ports.py`, vendor SDK / stdlib | `strategies`, `execution` (impl), `market_data` (impl), `dashboard` |
| `execution` (impl) | `domain`, `brokers/ports.py`, `persistence` ports, standard library | `strategies`, `dashboard`, concrete broker classes (receives them via ports) |
| `persistence`, `backtest`, `reporting`, `controls` | `domain`, ports, standard library | Concrete broker adapters, `strategies`, `dashboard` impl |
| `dashboard` | `domain`, `persistence` read projections, `config` redacted views | `execution`, `brokers`, `strategies`, `controls` inbox writes, `market_data` live feed |
| `observability`, `config` | Standard library + declared typing/validation libs | `brokers`, `execution`, `strategies`, `dashboard` |
| `app.py`, `runtime.py` (composition root) | All modules (wires concretes to ports) | N/A — sole exception; must not contain strategy or risk math |

Enforcement intent: keep `domain`/`strategies`/`risk` importable without
broker credentials, network, or database; keep `dashboard` importable without
execution/broker capability.

## 4. Data Flow

1. **Acquire once per symbol.** One `MarketDataService` owns one authenticated
   live connection for the union of watched symbols/channels. Each
   symbol/channel is subscribed once and fanned out as immutable events to
   every live/paper/shadow consumer. Bounded REST polling fallback fetches
   once per symbol/cycle and respects rate limits. Strategies never poll.
2. **Centralized candles/indicators.** Closed-bar finalization (e.g. 1-minute
   regular-session bars) and pure indicators (VWAP, EMA, RSI, ATR, volume) are
   computed once centrally and published as an immutable `MarketContext` with
   feed provenance (IEX vs SIP), source/receive timestamps, freshness, and
   session flags. IEX provenance is preserved because IEX is not consolidated
   SIP.
3. **One internal scheduler.** A single in-engine scheduler fires on completed
   bars during regular hours, enforces entry cutoff and optional
   end-of-day-close (disabled by default), and dispatches due evaluations.
4. **Bounded concurrent strategy evaluation.** A bounded worker pool evaluates
   independently registered BUY/SELL plugins against the shared context;
   duplicate signals on the same bar are suppressed; evaluations never block
   the feed.
5. **Serialized mutations through a single writer.** Signal routing, budget
   reservation, and per-account+symbol order serialization funnel into one
   authoritative SQLite writer / execution coordinator. Account/portfolio/order
   mutations are serialized so concurrent strategies cannot double-spend cash,
   oversell quantity, or race protective stops. Only `app.py`/`runtime.py`
   construct this writer.

On feed loss, stale/gapped data, or DEGRADED health, new entries fail closed
while broker fill/order-update ingestion continues on its separate channel.

## 5. Execution Modes

Four distinct modes with strict credential/ledger isolation. Cross-mode
credentials, account IDs, state directories, databases, positions, orders,
balances, limits, and ledgers must never leak or be shared.

| Mode | Feed | Broker access | Ledger | Isolation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `BACKTEST` | Deterministic historical bars only | None — no broker access, no credentials loaded | Ephemeral/isolated run manifest | Separate run key; cannot read live/paper/shadow state |
| `SHADOW` | Live shared feed (same cache as paper/live) | None — simulated broker only | Persistent per-scenario simulated ledger; multiple named scenarios may run concurrently on one shared stream | Per-scenario account/scenario key + database/ledger separation |
| `PAPER` | Live shared feed | Alpaca Paper (`https://paper-api.alpaca.markets`) with paper credentials only | Broker paper account + local paper ledger mirror | Paper endpoint/keys/DB/ledger separated from live and shadow |
| `LIVE` | Live shared feed | Alpaca Live (`https://api.alpaca.markets`) with live credentials only | Broker live account + local live ledger mirror | Live endpoint/keys/DB/ledger separated from all other modes |

**LIVE is explicitly gated.** Nothing in this architecture authorizes live
orders by itself. Live requires explicit operator enablement (explicit
live-mode selection plus `MIKE_TRADE_ENABLE_LIVE_TRADING=1`-style
confirmation), preflight, reconciliation, risk-cap review, broker
fingerprint/account verification, and stop/fractional capability checks.
Live-mutating CLI commands require explicit live confirmation. Tests, imports,
status reads, backtests, and shadow runs must never load or use live
credentials.

## 6. Persistence

- **Engine:** SQLite with Write-Ahead Logging
  (`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;`), foreign keys on,
  indexed UTC timestamps, transactions for atomic reservation/fill/cycle
  updates.
- **One authoritative writer:** exactly one engine process holds the write
  connection per operational database. Dashboard, reports, and CLI status read
  via read-only WAL projections without lock contention.
- **Migrations:** forward-only versioned SQL migrations (e.g.
  `mike_trade/persistence/migrations/0001_initial.sql` onward) applied in
  order with integrity checks; no destructive rewrites of trade history.
- **Append-only trade-affecting events:** signals, decisions, intents, order
  events, fills (keyed by unique external activity ID), protection orders,
  trailing state/events, budget reservations, cash events, equity snapshots,
  reconciliation runs, control commands, and config fingerprints are appended,
  never updated in place. Failed journal writes must not permit unrecorded
  accepted intent. Broker activity ingestion is idempotent.
- **Separation:** LIVE, PAPER, each named SHADOW scenario, and each BACKTEST
  run use explicit account/scenario/run keys; cross-mode writes are forbidden.
  No bulk raw tick archive; the cache keeps only latest quotes/trades,
  decision evidence, candle inputs, completed candles, rolling indicator state,
  and freshness metadata.
- **Backups:** backup/restore checks and maintenance utilities preserve
  ledger isolation and detect corruption.

## 7. Fail-Closed Entry Policy and Broker Truth

- **Fail-closed entries:** new entries are blocked (while fills, stops,
  reconciliation, manual closes, and safety exits remain enabled) on
  stale/unknown data, DEGRADED feed, unresolved/unknown orders, unreconciled
  broker state, unknown stop state, unsafe account flags, insufficient buying
  power, unsupported fractional/order combinations, or missing mandatory
  research inputs. Shutdown never implicitly liquidates or cancels valid
  broker-held protective stops. Startup reconciles broker account, positions,
  orders, fills, stops, budgets, and persistent strategy state before
  permitting new entries. External positions are UNMANAGED until explicit
  adoption/handling.
- **Broker truth is authoritative:** for live orders/positions the broker is
  authoritative. Local/broker discrepancies produce explicit reconciliation
  drift and block new entries until resolved; history is never silently
  rewritten. Every automated live long position requires broker-held
  protective coverage when the configured provider capability supports it;
  protection begins after confirmed positive fill, covers actual remaining
  quantity, never moves downward for a long, and is coordinated with
  discretionary exits so overlapping sells cannot create a short.

## 8. Non-Goals

Explicitly out of scope unless separately approved:

- No Kafka, Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ, or other generic message brokers.
- No Kubernetes, Helm, or multi-node container orchestration.
- No generic rules engines, DSLs, visual strategy builders, or throwaway
  untyped scripts; strategies are typed Python plugin classes.
- No Makefile business logic; recipes delegate to application services/CLI.
- No professional charting terminal; the dashboard is an operational status
  UI, not a charting product.
- No configuration-history/diff/preview product beyond an audited
  SHA-256/redacted effective-config fingerprint.
- No full-session raw tick recording; no bulk raw tick archive.
- No options, futures, crypto/forex; no automated stock screening; no
  mandatory ML/LLM decision-path inference; no browser broker automation; no
  exchange/microsecond smart routing; no capital transfers; no mandatory
  notifications; no earnings/economic blackout automation; no automatic live
  short selling (initial active trading is long-only; type/capability
  boundaries may anticipate future short/cover without enabling it).

"""Immutable strategy definitions, registrations, and evaluation results.

This module uses only the Python standard library.  In particular, it does
not import market, broker, account, order, or protection types at runtime.

Design choices (2 of 3 for these strategy/signal contracts):
1. Symbols are stripped and uppercased at the contract boundary, matching the
   normalization used by the rest of the domain while keeping strategy keys
   strictly lowercase snake_case.
2. Parameter mappings are defensively shallow-copied into ``MappingProxyType``;
   the contract makes the mapping itself read-only without prescribing or
   transforming strategy-specific parameter values.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from enum import Enum
from types import MappingProxyType
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from mike_trade.domain.signals import Signal

__all__ = [
    "StrategyRole",
    "StrategyDefinition",
    "StrategyInstance",
    "EvaluationStatus",
    "Evaluation",
]

_STRATEGY_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")


def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _read_only_mapping(value: object, *, field: str) -> Mapping[str, object]:
    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a mapping; got {type(value).__name__}")
    copied: dict[str, object] = {}
    for key, item in value.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} keys must be non-empty strings")
        copied[key] = item
    return MappingProxyType(copied)


def _string_tuple(value: object, *, field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a tuple")
    if any(not isinstance(item, str) or not item.strip() for item in value):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} items must be non-empty strings")
    return tuple(item.strip() for item in value)


class StrategyRole(Enum):
    """A strategy's independently registered entry or exit role."""

    BUY = "BUY"
    SELL = "SELL"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StrategyDefinition:
    """Static metadata and defaults published by a strategy plugin."""

    strategy_key: str
    version: str
    role: StrategyRole
    description: str
    required_timeframes: tuple[str, ...]
    warmup_bars: int
    default_parameters: Mapping[str, object]

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "strategy_key",
            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
        )
        object.__setattr__(self, "version", _require_non_empty_str(self.version, field="version"))
        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
        if not isinstance(self.description, str):
            raise ValueError("description must be str")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "required_timeframes",
            _string_tuple(self.required_timeframes, field="required_timeframes"),
        )
        if isinstance(self.warmup_bars, bool) or not isinstance(self.warmup_bars, int):
            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be int")
        if self.warmup_bars < 0:
            raise ValueError("warmup_bars must be >= 0")
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "default_parameters",
            _read_only_mapping(self.default_parameters, field="default_parameters"),
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class StrategyInstance:
    """One configured BUY or SELL strategy registration."""

    instance_id: str
    strategy_key: str
    strategy_version: str
    role: StrategyRole
    symbol: str
    account_scope_id: str
    parameters: Mapping[str, object]
    enabled: bool
    pair_key: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "instance_id", _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "strategy_key",
            _require_strategy_key(self.strategy_key, field="strategy_key"),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "strategy_version",
            _require_non_empty_str(self.strategy_version, field="strategy_version"),
        )
        if not isinstance(self.role, StrategyRole):
            raise ValueError(f"role must be StrategyRole; got {type(self.role).__name__}")
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol"))
        object.__setattr__(
            self,
            "account_scope_id",
            _require_non_empty_str(self.account_scope_id, field="account_scope_id"),
        )
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "parameters", _read_only_mapping(self.parameters, field="parameters")
        )
        if not isinstance(self.enabled, bool):
            raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
        if self.pair_key is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self, "pair_key", _require_non_empty_str(self.pair_key, field="pair_key")
            )


class EvaluationStatus(Enum):
    """The complete set of outcomes from one strategy evaluation."""

    NO_SIGNAL = "NO_SIGNAL"
    SIGNAL = "SIGNAL"
    INSUFFICIENT_DATA = "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"
    STALE_DATA = "STALE_DATA"
    ERROR = "ERROR"
    NOT_DUE = "NOT_DUE"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Evaluation:
    """The broker-neutral result of evaluating one strategy instance."""

    instance_id: str
    symbol: str
    evaluated_at: datetime
    bar_time: datetime | None
    status: EvaluationStatus
    signal: Signal | None
    reason: str
    error_detail: str | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        instance_id = _require_non_empty_str(self.instance_id, field="instance_id")
        symbol = _require_symbol(self.symbol, field="symbol")
        object.__setattr__(self, "instance_id", instance_id)
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
        object.__setattr__(
            self, "evaluated_at", _require_utc(self.evaluated_at, field="evaluated_at")
        )
        if self.bar_time is not None:
            object.__setattr__(self, "bar_time", _require_utc(self.bar_time, field="bar_time"))
        if not isinstance(self.status, EvaluationStatus):
            raise ValueError(
                f"status must be EvaluationStatus; got {type(self.status).__name__}"
            )
        if not isinstance(self.reason, str):
            raise ValueError("reason must be str")
        if self.error_detail is not None and not isinstance(self.error_detail, str):
            raise ValueError("error_detail must be str or None")

        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.SIGNAL:
            if self.signal is None:
                raise ValueError("SIGNAL evaluations require a signal")
            if getattr(self.signal, "instance_id", None) != instance_id:
                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal instance_id must match")
            if getattr(self.signal, "symbol", None) != symbol:
                raise ValueError("evaluation and signal symbol must match")
        elif self.signal is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.status.value} evaluations must not contain a signal")

        if self.status is EvaluationStatus.ERROR and not self.error_detail:
            raise ValueError("ERROR evaluations require error_detail")

+"""Immutable protective-stop policy and trailing-state contracts.
+
+This module imports the trading contract only for static type checking; at
+runtime, ``start_protection`` uses the small structural surface supplied by a
+position cycle.
+
+Design choice (the task's final design choice): ``with_covered_quantity``
+treats its argument as the authoritative actual remaining position and may
+therefore resize coverage either down or up; it rejects non-positive values,
+while over-coverage is detected before mutation by ``combined_sell_exposure``.

+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace

+    from mike_trade.domain.trading import PositionCycle

+    "ProtectionStatus",
+    "ProtectionPolicy",
+    "TrailingStopState",
+    "start_protection",
+    "combined_sell_exposure",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+

+def _require_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object) -> str:
+    symbol = _require_text(value, field="symbol").upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+    return symbol
+
+
+def _require_decimal(
+    value: object,
+    *,
+    field: str,
+    minimum: Decimal = _ZERO,
+    inclusive: bool = True,
+) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    if value < minimum or (not inclusive and value == minimum):
+        operator = ">=" if inclusive else ">"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator} {minimum}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _optional_decimal(
+    value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = True
+) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return _require_decimal(value, field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=not positive)
+
+
+def _optional_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):

+
+

+    PENDING = "PENDING"
+    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
+    REPLACING = "REPLACING"

+    TRIGGERED = "TRIGGERED"

+    stop_offset_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    step_size: Decimal | None = None
+    activation_gain: Decimal | None = None

+            "stop_offset_amount",
+            "trail_percent",
+            "trail_amount",

+                raise ValueError("BROKER_TRAILING_STOP accepts only a trail value")
+        else:

+                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
+            if self.step_size is None or self.activation_gain is None:
+                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires step_size and activation_gain")

+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "stop_price",
+            _require_decimal(

+            ),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(

+            "high_water_mark",
+            _require_decimal(

+                minimum=_ZERO,

+        )

+            raise ValueError("stop_price must not exceed high_water_mark for a long")
+        if self.broker_order_id is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "broker_order_id",
+                _require_text(self.broker_order_id, field="broker_order_id"),
+            )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "last_confirmed_at",
+            _optional_utc(self.last_confirmed_at, field="last_confirmed_at"),
+        )
+
+    def ratchet(self, new_stop_price: Decimal, observed_high: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
+        new_stop = _require_decimal(
+            new_stop_price, field="new_stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+        )
+        new_high = _require_decimal(
+            observed_high, field="observed_high", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+        )
+        if new_stop < self.stop_price:
+            raise ValueError("a long protective stop must never move downward")
+        if new_high < self.high_water_mark:
+            raise ValueError("a long high_water_mark must never move downward")
+        if new_stop > new_high:
+            raise ValueError("new_stop_price must not exceed observed_high")
+        return replace(self, stop_price=new_stop, high_water_mark=new_high)
+
+    def with_covered_quantity(self, remaining: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
+        quantity = _require_decimal(
+            remaining, field="remaining", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+        )
+        return replace(self, covered_quantity=quantity)
+
+
+def _offset_price(fill_price: Decimal, *, percent: Decimal | None, amount: Decimal | None) -> Decimal:
+    if amount is not None:
+        return fill_price - amount
+    if percent is None:  # Protected by ProtectionPolicy validation.
+        raise ValueError("a percent or amount offset is required")
+    return fill_price * (_require_decimal(Decimal("1"), field="one") - percent)
+
+
+def start_protection(
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy, cycle: "PositionCycle", fill_price: Decimal
+) -> TrailingStopState:
+    """Create pending protection after a confirmed positive entry fill."""
+
+    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+        raise ValueError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+    price = _require_decimal(
+        fill_price, field="fill_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+    )
+    entry_quantity = getattr(cycle, "entry_quantity", None)
+    remaining_quantity = getattr(cycle, "remaining_quantity", None)
+    if not isinstance(entry_quantity, Decimal) or entry_quantity <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive filled entry quantity")
+    if not isinstance(remaining_quantity, Decimal) or remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive remaining quantity")
+
+    if policy.kind is ProtectionKind.FIXED_STOP:
+        stop = _offset_price(
+            price,
+            percent=policy.stop_offset_percent,
+            amount=policy.stop_offset_amount,
+        )
+    else:
+        stop = _offset_price(
+            price, percent=policy.trail_percent, amount=policy.trail_amount
+        )
+    stop = _require_decimal(stop, field="stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False)
+    return TrailingStopState(
+        cycle_id=_require_text(getattr(cycle, "cycle_id", None), field="cycle_id"),
+        account_scope_id=_require_text(
+            getattr(cycle, "account_scope_id", None), field="account_scope_id"
+        ),
+        symbol=_require_symbol(getattr(cycle, "symbol", None)),
+        kind=policy.kind,
+        status=ProtectionStatus.PENDING,
+        covered_quantity=remaining_quantity,
+        stop_price=stop,
+        high_water_mark=price,
+    )
+
+

+    protective_qty: Decimal, pending_exit_qty: Decimal, position_qty: Decimal
+) -> bool:
+    """Report whether overlapping sell orders could create a short position."""
+
+    protective = _require_decimal(protective_qty, field="protective_qty")
+    pending = _require_decimal(pending_exit_qty, field="pending_exit_qty")
+    position = _require_decimal(position_qty, field="position_qty")
+    return protective + pending > position

+        if (quantity is None) == (notional is None):

+        object.__setattr__(self, "quantity", quantity)

+                field,

+                    getattr(self, field), field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+                ),

+        _validate_order_prices(
+            self.order_type,
+            self.limit_price,
+            self.stop_price,

+    order_type: OrderType
+    status: BrokerOrderStatus

+    filled_quantity: Decimal

+    updated_at: datetime

+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
+    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    replaced_by: str | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for field in ("broker_order_id", "client_order_id", "account_scope_id"):

+        object.__setattr__(self, "quantity", quantity)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "filled_quantity", filled)
+        average = _optional_decimal(
+            self.filled_avg_price,
+            field="filled_avg_price",
+            minimum=_ZERO,
+            inclusive=False,
+        )
+        if filled > _ZERO and average is None:
+            raise ValueError("filled_avg_price is required when filled_quantity is positive")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "filled_avg_price", average)
+        for field in ("limit_price", "stop_price", "trail_price", "trail_percent"):
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                field,
+                _optional_decimal(
+                    getattr(self, field), field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+                ),

+        _validate_order_prices(
+            self.order_type,

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class PositionCycle:
+    """A single long entry followed by a single complete discretionary exit."""
+
+    cycle_id: str
+    account_scope_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    direction: PositionDirection = PositionDirection.LONG
+    state: PositionCycleState = PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY
+    entry_strategy_key: str | None = None
+    entry_fills: tuple[Fill, ...] = ()
+    exit_fills: tuple[Fill, ...] = ()
+    opened_at: datetime | None = None
+    closed_at: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for field in ("cycle_id", "account_scope_id"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
+        _require_enum(self.direction, PositionDirection, field="direction")
+        if self.direction is not PositionDirection.LONG:
+            raise ValueError("SHORT position cycles are dormant")
+        _require_enum(self.state, PositionCycleState, field="state")
+        if self.entry_strategy_key is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "entry_strategy_key",
+                _require_text(self.entry_strategy_key, field="entry_strategy_key"),
+            )
+        if not isinstance(self.entry_fills, tuple) or not isinstance(self.exit_fills, tuple):
+            raise ValueError("entry_fills and exit_fills must be tuples")
+
+        all_fills = self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills
+        if any(not isinstance(fill, Fill) for fill in all_fills):
+            raise ValueError("cycle fills must be Fill instances")
+        fill_ids = [fill.fill_id for fill in all_fills]
+        if len(fill_ids) != len(set(fill_ids)):
+            raise ValueError("fill_id values must be unique within a cycle")
+        for fill in all_fills:
+            if fill.account_scope_id != self.account_scope_id or fill.symbol != self.symbol:
+                raise ValueError("fill account_scope_id and symbol must match the cycle")
+        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY for fill in self.entry_fills):
+            raise ValueError("entry fills must have BUY side")
+        if any(fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL for fill in self.exit_fills):
+            raise ValueError("exit fills must have SELL side")
+        if self.exit_quantity > self.entry_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")
+
+        opened_at = _optional_utc(self.opened_at, field="opened_at")
+        closed_at = _optional_utc(self.closed_at, field="closed_at")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "opened_at", opened_at)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "closed_at", closed_at)
+        if opened_at is not None and closed_at is not None and closed_at < opened_at:
+            raise ValueError("closed_at must not be before opened_at")
+
+        if self.state is PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY:
+            if all_fills or opened_at is not None or closed_at is not None:
+                raise ValueError("PENDING_ENTRY cycles cannot contain fills or lifecycle times")
+        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.OPEN:
+            if not self.entry_fills or self.exit_fills or opened_at is None or closed_at is not None:
+                raise ValueError("OPEN cycles require entry fills only and opened_at")
+        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.EXITING:
+            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require a positive remaining quantity")
+            if opened_at is None or closed_at is not None:
+                raise ValueError("EXITING cycles require opened_at and no closed_at")
+        elif self.state is PositionCycleState.CLOSED:
+            if not self.entry_fills or self.remaining_quantity != _ZERO:
+                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require a fully exited entry")
+            if opened_at is None or closed_at is None:
+                raise ValueError("CLOSED cycles require opened_at and closed_at")
+        elif closed_at is not None and opened_at is None:
+            raise ValueError("an ABANDONED cycle cannot close before it opens")
+
+    def apply_entry_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
+        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
+            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
+        if self.state not in {PositionCycleState.PENDING_ENTRY, PositionCycleState.OPEN}:
+            raise ValueError("entry fills are allowed only before exit begins")
+        if self.exit_fills:
+            raise ValueError("entry fills are not allowed after an exit fill")
+        if fill.side is not OrderSide.BUY:
+            raise ValueError("entry fill side must be BUY")
+        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills}:
+            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
+        opened_at = self.opened_at if self.opened_at is not None else fill.filled_at
+        return replace(
+            self,
+            state=PositionCycleState.OPEN,
+            entry_fills=self.entry_fills + (fill,),
+            opened_at=opened_at,
+        )
+
+    def begin_exit(self) -> PositionCycle:
+        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.OPEN or self.remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+            raise ValueError("exit can begin only for an OPEN cycle with remaining quantity")
+        return replace(self, state=PositionCycleState.EXITING)
+
+    def apply_exit_fill(self, fill: Fill) -> PositionCycle:
+        if not isinstance(fill, Fill):
+            raise ValueError("fill must be Fill")
+        if self.state is not PositionCycleState.EXITING:
+            raise ValueError("exit fills require an EXITING cycle")
+        if fill.side is not OrderSide.SELL:
+            raise ValueError("exit fill side must be SELL")
+        if fill.fill_id in {item.fill_id for item in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills}:
+            raise ValueError("fill_id already exists in cycle")
+        if fill.quantity > self.remaining_quantity:
+            raise ValueError("cumulative exit quantity must not exceed entry quantity")
+        fills = self.exit_fills + (fill,)
+        if fill.quantity == self.remaining_quantity:
+            return replace(
+                self,
+                state=PositionCycleState.CLOSED,
+                exit_fills=fills,
+                closed_at=fill.filled_at,
+            )
+        return replace(self, exit_fills=fills)
+
+    @property
+    def entry_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)
+
+    @property
+    def exit_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return sum((fill.quantity for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+
+    @property
+    def remaining_quantity(self) -> Decimal:
+        return self.entry_quantity - self.exit_quantity
+
+    @property
+    def avg_entry_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        if self.entry_quantity == _ZERO:
+            return None
+        cost = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        return cost / self.entry_quantity
+
+    @property
+    def avg_exit_price(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        if self.exit_quantity == _ZERO:
+            return None
+        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        return proceeds / self.exit_quantity
+
+    @property
+    def realized_pnl(self) -> Decimal:
+        proceeds = sum((fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        entry_cost = sum(
+            (fill.quantity * fill.price for fill in self.entry_fills), start=_ZERO
+        )
+        fees = sum((fill.fee for fill in self.entry_fills + self.exit_fills), start=_ZERO)
+        return proceeds - entry_cost - fees
+
+

+"""Immutable protective-stop policy and trailing-state contracts.
+
+This module imports the trading contract only for static type checking; at
+runtime, ``start_protection`` uses the small structural surface supplied by a
+position cycle.
+
+Design choice (the task's final design choice): ``with_covered_quantity``
+treats its argument as the authoritative actual remaining position and may
+therefore resize coverage either down or up; it rejects non-positive values,
+while over-coverage is detected before mutation by ``combined_sell_exposure``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from mike_trade.domain.trading import PositionCycle
+
+__all__ = [
+    "ProtectionKind",
+    "ProtectionStatus",
+    "ProtectionPolicy",
+    "TrailingStopState",
+    "start_protection",
+    "combined_sell_exposure",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+
+
+def _require_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _require_symbol(value: object) -> str:
+    symbol = _require_text(value, field="symbol").upper()
+    if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+    return symbol
+
+
+def _require_decimal(
+    value: object,
+    *,
+    field: str,
+    minimum: Decimal = _ZERO,
+    inclusive: bool = True,
+) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal; got {type(value).__name__}")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    if value < minimum or (not inclusive and value == minimum):
+        operator = ">=" if inclusive else ">"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator} {minimum}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _optional_decimal(
+    value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = True
+) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return _require_decimal(value, field=field, minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=not positive)
+
+
+def _optional_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime")
+    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+class ProtectionKind(Enum):
+    FIXED_STOP = "FIXED_STOP"
+    BROKER_TRAILING_STOP = "BROKER_TRAILING_STOP"
+    STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP = "STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP"
+
+
+class ProtectionStatus(Enum):
+    PENDING = "PENDING"
+    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
+    REPLACING = "REPLACING"
+    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"
+    CANCELED = "CANCELED"
+    TRIGGERED = "TRIGGERED"
+    UNSUPPORTED = "UNSUPPORTED"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ProtectionPolicy:
+    kind: ProtectionKind
+    stop_offset_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    stop_offset_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None
+    trail_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    step_size: Decimal | None = None
+    activation_gain: Decimal | None = None
+    require_broker_held: bool = True
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.kind, ProtectionKind):
+            raise ValueError("kind must be ProtectionKind")
+        for field in (
+            "stop_offset_percent",
+            "stop_offset_amount",
+            "trail_percent",
+            "trail_amount",
+            "step_size",
+        ):
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self, field, _optional_decimal(getattr(self, field), field=field)
+            )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "activation_gain",
+            _optional_decimal(self.activation_gain, field="activation_gain", positive=False),
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.require_broker_held, bool):
+            raise ValueError("require_broker_held must be bool")
+
+        stop_count = int(self.stop_offset_percent is not None) + int(
+            self.stop_offset_amount is not None
+        )
+        trail_count = int(self.trail_percent is not None) + int(
+            self.trail_amount is not None
+        )
+        if self.kind is ProtectionKind.FIXED_STOP:
+            if stop_count != 1:
+                raise ValueError("FIXED_STOP requires exactly one stop offset")
+            if trail_count or self.step_size is not None or self.activation_gain is not None:
+                raise ValueError("FIXED_STOP does not accept trailing or stepped fields")
+        elif self.kind is ProtectionKind.BROKER_TRAILING_STOP:
+            if trail_count != 1:
+                raise ValueError("BROKER_TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
+            if stop_count or self.step_size is not None or self.activation_gain is not None:
+                raise ValueError("BROKER_TRAILING_STOP accepts only a trail value")
+        else:
+            if trail_count != 1:
+                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
+            if self.step_size is None or self.activation_gain is None:
+                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP requires step_size and activation_gain")
+            if stop_count:
+                raise ValueError("STEPPED_TRAILING_STOP does not accept fixed-stop fields")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TrailingStopState:
+    cycle_id: str
+    account_scope_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    kind: ProtectionKind
+    status: ProtectionStatus
+    covered_quantity: Decimal
+    stop_price: Decimal
+    high_water_mark: Decimal
+    broker_order_id: str | None = None
+    last_confirmed_at: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        for field in ("cycle_id", "account_scope_id"):
+            object.__setattr__(self, field, _require_text(getattr(self, field), field=field))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _require_symbol(self.symbol))
+        if not isinstance(self.kind, ProtectionKind):
+            raise ValueError("kind must be ProtectionKind")
+        if not isinstance(self.status, ProtectionStatus):
+            raise ValueError("status must be ProtectionStatus")
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "covered_quantity",
+            _require_decimal(
+                self.covered_quantity,
+                field="covered_quantity",
+                minimum=_ZERO,
+                inclusive=False,
+            ),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "stop_price",
+            _require_decimal(
+                self.stop_price, field="stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+            ),
+        )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "high_water_mark",
+            _require_decimal(
+                self.high_water_mark,
+                field="high_water_mark",
+                minimum=_ZERO,
+                inclusive=False,
+            ),
+        )
+        if self.stop_price > self.high_water_mark:
+            raise ValueError("stop_price must not exceed high_water_mark for a long")
+        if self.broker_order_id is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(
+                self,
+                "broker_order_id",
+                _require_text(self.broker_order_id, field="broker_order_id"),
+            )
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self,
+            "last_confirmed_at",
+            _optional_utc(self.last_confirmed_at, field="last_confirmed_at"),
+        )
+
+    def ratchet(self, new_stop_price: Decimal, observed_high: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
+        new_stop = _require_decimal(
+            new_stop_price, field="new_stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+        )
+        new_high = _require_decimal(
+            observed_high, field="observed_high", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+        )
+        if new_stop < self.stop_price:
+            raise ValueError("a long protective stop must never move downward")
+        if new_high < self.high_water_mark:
+            raise ValueError("a long high_water_mark must never move downward")
+        if new_stop > new_high:
+            raise ValueError("new_stop_price must not exceed observed_high")
+        return replace(self, stop_price=new_stop, high_water_mark=new_high)
+
+    def with_covered_quantity(self, remaining: Decimal) -> TrailingStopState:
+        quantity = _require_decimal(
+            remaining, field="remaining", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+        )
+        return replace(self, covered_quantity=quantity)
+
+
+def _offset_price(fill_price: Decimal, *, percent: Decimal | None, amount: Decimal | None) -> Decimal:
+    if amount is not None:
+        return fill_price - amount
+    if percent is None:  # Protected by ProtectionPolicy validation.
+        raise ValueError("a percent or amount offset is required")
+    return fill_price * (_require_decimal(Decimal("1"), field="one") - percent)
+
+
+def start_protection(
+    policy: ProtectionPolicy, cycle: "PositionCycle", fill_price: Decimal
+) -> TrailingStopState:
+    """Create pending protection after a confirmed positive entry fill."""
+
+    if not isinstance(policy, ProtectionPolicy):
+        raise ValueError("policy must be ProtectionPolicy")
+    price = _require_decimal(
+        fill_price, field="fill_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False
+    )
+    entry_quantity = getattr(cycle, "entry_quantity", None)
+    remaining_quantity = getattr(cycle, "remaining_quantity", None)
+    if not isinstance(entry_quantity, Decimal) or entry_quantity <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive filled entry quantity")
+    if not isinstance(remaining_quantity, Decimal) or remaining_quantity <= _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError("protection requires a positive remaining quantity")
+
+    if policy.kind is ProtectionKind.FIXED_STOP:
+        stop = _offset_price(
+            price,
+            percent=policy.stop_offset_percent,
+            amount=policy.stop_offset_amount,
+        )
+    else:
+        stop = _offset_price(
+            price, percent=policy.trail_percent, amount=policy.trail_amount
+        )
+    stop = _require_decimal(stop, field="stop_price", minimum=_ZERO, inclusive=False)
+    return TrailingStopState(
+        cycle_id=_require_text(getattr(cycle, "cycle_id", None), field="cycle_id"),
+        account_scope_id=_require_text(
+            getattr(cycle, "account_scope_id", None), field="account_scope_id"
+        ),
+        symbol=_require_symbol(getattr(cycle, "symbol", None)),
+        kind=policy.kind,
+        status=ProtectionStatus.PENDING,
+        covered_quantity=remaining_quantity,
+        stop_price=stop,
+        high_water_mark=price,
+    )
+
+
+def combined_sell_exposure(
+    protective_qty: Decimal, pending_exit_qty: Decimal, position_qty: Decimal
+) -> bool:
+    """Report whether overlapping sell orders could create a short position."""
+
+    protective = _require_decimal(protective_qty, field="protective_qty")
+    pending = _require_decimal(pending_exit_qty, field="pending_exit_qty")
+    position = _require_decimal(position_qty, field="position_qty")
+    return protective + pending > position
